description: Facebook is a social media company that allows people to connect, share content, and communicate globally through online platforms.
Microsoft develops software, hardware, and cloud services, best known for Windows, Office, and its enterprise technology solutions.
Google specializes in internet-related services and products, including search engines, online advertising, cloud computing, and AI technologies.
Oracle is a multinational technology company known for database software, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise business solutions.
Nvidia designs graphics processing units and AI computing technologies used in gaming, data centers, and artificial intelligence.
IBM provides enterprise technology solutions including cloud computing, artificial intelligence, consulting, and IT infrastructure services.
Tesla is an electric vehicle and clean energy company focused on sustainable transportation and renewable energy solutions.
Apple designs consumer electronics, software, and digital services, known for innovative products like the iPhone, Mac, and iOS ecosystem.
Amazon is a global e-commerce and technology company offering online retail, cloud computing services, and digital streaming platforms.
Flipkart is a leading Indian e-commerce company providing online retail services across electronics, fashion, and household products.
OpenAI is an artificial intelligence research organization focused on developing safe and beneficial AI technologies for humanity.
Reliance is an Indian multinational conglomerate operating across energy, retail, telecommunications, and digital services.
Airtel is a leading global telecommunications company providing mobile, broadband, and digital TV services.
Jio is an Indian telecom company offering high-speed internet, mobile connectivity, and digital ecosystem services.
SpaceX is an aerospace company focused on developing reusable rockets and spacecraft to enable affordable space travel.
Mercedes-Benz Group is a German multinational automotive company that designs, manufactures, and sells luxury vehicles, commercial vehicles, and mobility services worldwide.
Tata Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate operating in industries such as steel, automotive, information technology, telecommunications, energy, and consumer goods globally.
Tencent is a Chinese multinational technology corporation providing social networking, digital entertainment, gaming, cloud computing, and financial technology services worldwide.
LinkedIn is a professional networking and career development platform that allows users to connect with colleagues, share professional content, and search for jobs. It is owned by Microsoft.
YouTube is an online video-sharing and social media platform where users can upload, watch, and share videos. It is owned by Google (Alphabet Inc.).
Telegram is a cloud-based instant messaging platform known for its speed, security, and end-to-end encrypted communication features.
Snapchat is a multimedia messaging application that allows users to send photos and videos that disappear after being viewed. It is developed by Snap Inc.
Zomato is an Indian multinational food delivery and restaurant discovery platform that allows users to search for restaurants, read reviews, and order food online.
Wipro is an Indian multinational corporation that provides information technology, consulting, and business process services to clients globally.
Samsung is a South Korean multinational conglomerate known globally for its electronics products, including smartphones, televisions, semiconductors, and home appliances.
Perplexity is an AI-powered search engine company that provides conversational answers to user queries using large language models and real-time web data.

Neuralink is a neurotechnology company developing implantable brain–computer interfaces intended to help treat neurological conditions and enable direct communication between the human brain and computers.
Uber Technologies Inc. is a global mobility company that provides ride-hailing, food delivery (Uber Eats), freight transport, and logistics services through its digital platform.
Netflix Inc. is a subscription-based streaming service that offers online streaming of films, television series, documentaries, and original content worldwide.
Twitter, now rebranded as X and owned by X Corp., is a social networking platform that enables users to post and interact with short messages known as posts.
Airbnb Inc. is an online marketplace that connects people who want to rent out their homes with people looking for accommodations, experiences, and tourism services.
Zoom Video Communications Inc. provides video conferencing, online meetings, chat, and mobile collaboration services through its cloud-based platform.
Spotify Technology S.A. is a digital music, podcast, and audiobook streaming service that provides access to millions of songs and audio content globally.

Intel Corporation is a global technology company known for designing and manufacturing microprocessors, semiconductor chips, and other computing hardware used in personal computers, servers, and data centers.
PayPal Holdings, Inc. is an online payments system that supports money transfers and serves as an electronic alternative to traditional paper methods like checks and money orders.
Nike, Inc. is a multinational corporation engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, and marketing of footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories for sports and fitness.
